title: A silicon slab between silica, in a box
shows: A 250 nm silicon layer (n² = 12.11) between silica (n² = 2.085) at 1.55 µm, filling the width of a 2 µm box whose walls hold the field at zero: the mode separates into the slab's TE₀ mode (n = 2.9409, from tan(κd/2) = γ/κ) times sin(πx/W), so n_eff = √(n_slab² − (λ/2W)²) = 2.9152. 64 cells across the height.
source: Symmetric slab waveguide: K. Okamoto, Fundamentals of Optical Waveguides, 2nd ed. (2006), §2.1; D. Marcuse, Theory of Dielectric Optical Waveguides (1974), ch. 1.
